name: exo
description: One engineering process for Claude Code: skills that take turns, and agents and prompts that keep discovery off the main context.

specs.title: Where shaping stores specs
specs.description: docs: files under docs/specs. issues: GitHub issues. both: a file plus a linked issue. Not sure? Keep docs. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

replies.title: How replies are written
replies.description: tight: no preamble, recap or filler; code, paths, errors and warnings stay whole. standard: full prose. An output style outranks this. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

interview.title: Where shaping asks its questions
interview.description: chat: in the conversation, answered with a digit. page: a browser tab that shows every open and closed decision, answered with one click, for a few hundred extra tokens per question. Not sure? Keep chat. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.

context.title: Context before a fresh phase
context.description: Thousands of tokens the session's context may reach; past it, the next phase of a skill runs in a helper or hands off. Not sure? Keep 80. A project overrides this in .claude/exo.json.
